A real 'how many digits can we actually claim' policy question for default-precision N(), not a one-line fix.

N(Pi^10, {Infinity, n}) is Wolfram's precision-GOAL spec (n significant digits, no bound on working precision) — same double-precision-ceiling gap as the plain N(..., 50) rows here, just a different Wolfram precision-spec shape. Real feature gap.
